verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs say you can declare a `schedule` field on a workflow and Mastra will fire it on the specified cron (mastra-docs-43), and that a schedule can run an agent on a cron cadence (mastra-docs-47). Together these cover recurring jobs for both workflows and agents. Both are single-line claims from the vendor's own docs, so depth is thin. missing for 10: detailed scheduling docs (timezones, missed-run/overlap handling, schedule management or observability), clarity on whether scheduling works in self-hosted vs. hosted deployments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
